name: kornia-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Kornia, a differentiable computer vision library built on PyTorch. This task
covers its image-processing core: colour space conversions and colour maps, linear and non-linear filters,
kernels, border handling and edge detection, intensity enhancement, histograms and normalisation, morphology,
loss functions and their reductions, and evaluation metrics.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the Python modules under kornia/color/, kornia/filters/, kornia/enhance/, kornia/morphology/, kornia/losses/ and kornia/metrics/, except kornia/filters/dexined.py and kornia/filters/dissolving.py, together with the documentation pages docs/source/color.rst, docs/source/filters.rst, docs/source/enhance.rst, docs/source/morphology.rst, docs/source/losses.rst and docs/source/metrics.rst, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the documentation.
